caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing human figure on a rectangular pedestal base. The figure is dressed in a draped outfit primarily colored in shades of olive green and brown, with red fringes and decorative elements at the hem and sleeves. The figure wears a yellow and green sash across the chest and a large circular medallion hung around the neck. It has long, dark brown hair and wears a yellow headband or diadem. The figure’s right hand is holding a green leafy bundle, while the left arm holds a closed book with a brown cover, resting across the midsection. There is a yellow cloak draped over the figure's left shoulder and falling behind. The shoes or boots are dark brown, and the platform on which the statue stands is greyish brown with visible layered edges. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Indian Figure
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
